JOIN US

At Tata Unistore, we are dedicated to excellence and innovation across every aspect of online business — from fashion and technology to creative arts and logistics.

Working with us means staying ahead of trends and moving quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic environment across a variety of challenging and fulfilling roles.

We are constantly looking for talented individuals who can help us take our business to the next level and keep us at the forefront of the digital domain.

Explore job opportunities with us: https://cliqonnect.darwinbox.in/ms/candidate/careers

BEWARE OF FAKE JOB OFFERS

Dear Job Seeker:

Tata UniStore Limited (TUL) owns and operates the online e-commerce platforms Tata CLiQ Fashion and Tata CLiQ Luxury, accessible through the websites (www.tatacliq.com and www.luxury.tatacliq.com) and the respective mobile applications.

TUL is part of the Tata Group — a global enterprise headquartered in India, comprising more than 100 operating companies across 100+ countries and employing over 6,50,000 people worldwide. As an emerging and evolving business, TUL actively hires talent, and information regarding vacancies is communicated only through official channels.

As a socially aware and responsible organisation, we would like to issue a caution to all job seekers.

We have been alerted about fraudulent individuals/agencies/job portals contacting job seekers via unauthorised calls, emails, SMS, or WhatsApp links, offering job opportunities in Tata companies and demanding money as a refundable security deposit or other fees. Some even use fake letterheads with the Tata logo and forged HR signatures.

Please note:
TUL follows a merit-based recruitment process and never demands or accepts money — whether as a security deposit or any other payment — from job applicants.

If you receive an interview call or letter claiming to be from a Tata company, please verify its authenticity immediately. Do not share original documents or make any payment in cash or via bank transfers.

TUL never sends emails asking for credit card numbers or personal financial information, nor do we charge participants for competitions, marketing promotions, or campaigns. Exercise caution when opening links or attachments from unknown parties. Any communication requesting payment is against Tata policy.

Disclaimer:

Anyone engaging with such fraudulent interview calls does so at their own risk. TUL will not be held responsible for any loss or damage suffered, directly or indirectly.

We assume no liability for representations made in fraudulent communications or for their consequences. Such communications must not be treated as any form of offer or representation by TUL.
